alternatives.description: Leave update actions with algebra usage receipts but no exact repo-SHA/target-kind/profile binding.
alternatives.projected_effect: Issue #41 remains open and recent governed update evidence stays STALE_EVIDENCE/NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE.
alternatives.risk: An algebra usage receipt can be semantically valid yet detached from the exact repository mutation it is being cited for.

alternatives.description: Add a non-authorizing AlgebraBoundUpdateReceipt validator and exact backfills for the two affected governed SHAs, while retaining v1.4 as the sole current process.
alternatives.projected_effect: Update evidence gains deterministic exact-SHA, target-kind, ProcessVersion, DesignEpoch/source-root and algebra-profile binding without changing Garden canon or authority.
alternatives.risk: Adds another evidence record type and validator that must remain synchronized with the existing evolution algebra profile and audit chain.

bidirectional_gaps.gap: DO_NOTHING cannot deterministically prove that an algebra receipt belongs to the exact governed update SHA and target class.
The repair adds maintenance and must avoid becoming a second authorization or process layer.

assumptions: GardenCanonicalUpdateProcess v1.4 remains the sole HUMAN-admitted current update process.
Garden v15.5 remains immutable canonical design.
Issue #41 is validated execution-derived evidence of a missing exact update-to-algebra binding.
The existing GardenEvolutionAlgebraUsageReceipt validator remains the owner of algebra operator/law/non-law semantics.
An algebra-bound receipt may validate provenance/conformance but may not grant merge, admission, promotion, delegation or policy authority.
reason.uncertainty: Policy, Decision and Evidence executable algebra bindings remain frontiered; the repair intentionally preserves those frontiers and does not attempt to close them.
counterexamples: A receipt bound to the wrong repo SHA must fail even if its algebra usage is otherwise valid.
A PUBLIC_REPO update mislabeled CANONICAL_DESIGN must fail.
An unregistered Process operator or missing required Process non-law acknowledgement must fail.
A receipt citing a stale DesignEpoch/source root/profile blob must fail.
A receipt claiming semantic compliance or authority while frontiers remain must fail.
An inaccessible parallel-chat patch must not be reconstructed from summary text and silently admitted.
reason.conclusion: Implement the exact binding validator and backfill the two affected SHAs, keep all authority and canonical semantics unchanged, and treat the inaccessible parallel grammar patch as reference-only until exact bytes are available.

obligations.statement: The validator rejects stale repo, ProcessVersion, DesignEpoch, source-root and algebra-profile bindings.
The validator accepts only registered Process operators and required non-law acknowledgements supported by the bound usage receipt.
The bound receipt cannot mint authority or claim semantic compliance while required algebra frontiers remain.
Both issue-41 affected historical SHAs validate against persisted backfilled usage/validation/bound receipts.

items.claim_scope: Records the HIGH execution-derived defect: valid algebra usage existed without exact target-kind/repo-SHA algebra-bound update closure.
GardenCanonicalUpdateProcess v1.4 is HUMAN-admitted current and execution-first.
Defines registered Process operators/non-laws and preserves Policy/Decision/Evidence frontiers.
Existing validator checks bounded algebra use but does not bind an exact repository update SHA or target kind.
Reported editorial grammar patch is reference-only because source bytes are not available through the connected GitHub installation.
